test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is: **terms of**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Terms of"** refers to regarding or in relation to. ("के लिहाज से").

 
 
• **Example:** Sustainable agriculture is essential in terms of ensuring food security and protecting the environment.
 
 
 
• **'Terms of '** is contextually correct as it tells us that sustainable agriculture, in relation to food security, is important for holistic rural development. 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **terms of**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Condition of"** refers to the state or situation in particular. ("की स्थिति में").
 
• **"Time of"** indicates a specific moment. "समय के दौरान".
 
• **"Spite of" **means despite. ("के बावजूद").

11e:T780,

The correct answer is: **for.**
